card.name: Words just before a villain or wrongdoer
card.fires_on: Small linking words or quote marks right before a word for a wrongdoer or bad trait, such as ruffians, sinner, tyrant, or one committing violence. The next word is expected to be a negative label or a greedy or predatory act.

modes.label: Quote before a negative label
modes.description: An opening quote mark before a derogatory label in a list of insults or a villain's name.

modes.label: Link before wrongdoing
modes.description: A linking word like who, that, to or they right before a description of a wrongdoer or harmful act.
modes.example: The only person to blame is the one<< who>> is committing the violent acts.

card.writes: It pushes toward words for greed, plunder, villainy and brutality, mostly Chinese terms for greedy or cunning.
card.plain: It fires on little words that come just before a bad guy or a wicked deed is named.
